streaming_strategy.fit: STL decomposition + theta smoothing on full series.
streaming_strategy.predict: extend theta lines, add seasonal component.

inv.tier1_core_exception: Single-series forecasting; n<=1e6 typical; STM on STL requires full-series seasonal decomposition. Not a fit-matrix model.
inv.purpose: Theta method (STM variant): STL decomposition -> OLS theta_0 (trend) + SES theta_2 (curvature) -> 0.5/0.5 combine -> reseasonalize. Capability flags: handles_trend=True, handles_seasonality=True. KNOWN LIMITATION: STM underperforms on trend-dominated series (MASE 1.4 vs AutoETS 0.5 on synthetic trend=0.3,season_amp=3) — SES on theta_2 lags behind trend by (1-alpha)/alpha*slope per step; STL fixes decomposition leak but not SES lag. This is the STM baseline; OTM variant (weight optimisation) in backlog. Use for M3-like series where seasonality dominates trend.
